checks: Stadium removed; the distribution/capacity relation and state equations are primary.
Attendance remains expectation of min(d,K), not min(E[d],K).
Price response is explicitly assumed; no estimated elasticity is claimed.
Revenue adds ticket and other revenue; borrowing/valuation arrows into profit were removed.
Profit, interest and cash/debt stock identities are visible and source-grounded.
ΔE/ΔP and leverage use named ports; a leftward next-iteration arrow replaces the erroneous two-ended return.
notes: §7.2 states weighted aggregation, while later scenarios use revenue multiples. This contradiction is explicitly retained in the figure; no weights invented.
Profit is used in the source's simplified cash book, not relabelled as a fully specified cash-flow model.
Some connections are communicated by repeated variable names / ports, not continuous cables. This is a conceptual overview, not an executable wiring specification.
Typographic/density refinement can be judged by the user; no production-quality or user-acceptance seal is claimed.
